items.title: Schools Out For Summer
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Summer break, summer fun! Get ready for the best season of your life! Grab a couple of friends because you’re heading out to a private summer resort! New clothes! New season! New adventure! Your fun begins!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ 1 free skin!
+ By 4theSenpai

items.title: Lucky Loot Mob Skyblock
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Free yourself from the fears of being in the sky alone! This skyblock map has a lucky one block loot generator on each island! Whenever you break the item on a designated podium it will generate new random loot. Be careful though, some of these random items might frighten you! 
* Skyblock with a twist!
* Lucky one block loot generator!
* Carefree skins included!

items.title: Teen Halos
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Gimme, gimme that halo. Angels have descended onto on world to live a casual modern life! Oh wait, that is you! You're looking great!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Modern, casual attire!

items.title: The Last Knight
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
The last knight walks a lonely road. No chivalry to be found. No master to serve. No purpose to strive to protect. Where does this long road end? No one knows.

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Medieval, battle attire!

items.title: DJ Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Be the ultimate DJ mob and blast your favorite music! ... Maybe build the club first!

- 8 mob skins!

This skin set includes:

- Creeper
- Enderman
- Zombie
- Spider
- Slime
- Pig
- Skeleton
- Piglin

items.title: Power Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
With their new power armor, these mobs have levelled up! Stand out from the crowd with a variety of powerful looking mob skins!

A set of 8 skins!

Includes the following:

- Creeper
- Enderman
- Zombie
- Pig
- Spider
- Drowned
- Skeleton
- Slime

items.title: Mob Hoodies
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These teens just picked up some new mob hoodies, fresh off the rack! Must have hoodies for any wardrobe!

- 8 mob fashion skins!
- Creeper, Enderman, Skeleton, Zombie, and more!

items.title: Power Horns
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Woah, looks like these power armors have upgrades, and now they have horns! Be sure to stand out from the crowd by picking the skin that suits you best!

- 8 skins!
- Wide variety of designs and colors so you can find one that represents you!

items.title: Future Teens
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to play as a teen from the future with the advanced look? How about trying these skins with a perfect futuristic look with aesthetic vibes. It is about time to join the game and shine with your new, fresh look.

+ Teen
+ Fashion
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Anime Shinobi 2
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
The second addition to the legendary skin pack. As heroes from the first skin pack entered the game and proved their might it is up to their friends to join the battle and follow. Gather up with friends and show them that you are the strongest ninja in your village.

+ Anime roleplay
+ Shinobi appearance
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Mobs & Blocks: New Update
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Let your character shine with new skins from In Mine, inspired by the newest update. Amaze your friends with your new look and be the first to enter the game ready to be fully immersed in it!

+ Better Minecraft experiences!
+ 2 free skins
+ By In Mine

items.title: Sky Block Squad
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
The squad is here and ready for a sky block adventure! If you love sky themed skins then this skin pack will be a wonderful addition for your collection!

- 10 skins

items.title: Rally
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Race through the coolest terrains with the coolest cars! Minecraft racing has never seen environments so stunning before! Customize the tracks, choose your car, race your friends and enjoy! What are you waiting for, start your engine and drive your dream Rally!

+ Realistic terrains
+ Cars
+ Race your friends!
+ 2 free skins!

items.title: Streaming House
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Life your dream life as a professional streamer. Move into your very own streaming house with your friends. Decorate your mansion with unique customizable gaming furniture and make crazy livestreams with your computer, consoles, supercar and pool.

+ Customizable gaming furniture
+ Customize your streaming setup
+ Huge modern Mansion
+ Fast car

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Teen Couples Skin Pack
items.creator: Ninja Squirrel Gaming
items.description:
Looking for a matching skin to wear with a friend or loved one? Teen Couples has 5 matching sets perfect for that occasion! Look cute wearing a variety of modern outfits that are perfect for a school or casual roleplay! 

- Includes 10 skins and 5 matching ones!
- By Ninja Squirrel Gaming

items.title: Rich Anime Style
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
A new anime realm is born. Is this fantasy or real life? Welcome into this new Minecraft wonderland and discover the wonders of being a millionaire! Meet trendy teens who wear the latest fashion while showing off their luxury and style. Hang out in your mansions and become the best of friends with all the other anime fans!

+ Rich looking attire
+ 12 anime-themed skins

items.title: Oceanic Animals
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Welcome to Oceanic Animals! Walk through the aquarium to see sea animals! 

+ 6 new animal additions!
+ 8 skins included!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Wild Camo
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Camouflage in nature with one of these wild skins! The elements are so beautiful aren't they?

- 11 skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Summer Animals
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Become a cool summer time animal today! You can be an intelligent orca or maybe a cute playful seal. It's time for fun in the sun this summer!

- 11 skins

items.title: Fear Us 2
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
If you love all things horror then this skin pack is for you! These monsters want you to fear them and like when you scream! With these skins you can become a scary creature and haunt your friends! Are you afraid of the dark?

- 10 skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: UP Protector Crew
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
In a galaxy at war, six alien planets have come together to form the United Planets (UP).
Their mission to bring peace to the galaxy.
Join the crew of UP-Protector in Mobblock ever-expanding Galactic wars.

items.title: Jungle Oasis
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Tired of working? Come visit this GIANT island oasis! Explore the whole island to find many beautiful locations but be aware of the volcano on the top.

+ 700x700 giant island!
+ Beautiful fantasy mansion house.

- By Orbital Studios and 4KS Studios

items.title: Star Heroes
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
The battle continues in space, who will you embody? The heroes or the villains? You choose!

- 9 star heroes skins
- By Pixelusion & SucreGappySan

items.title: City Survival
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Start your Minecraft journey with this city! Perfect for your survival adventures and roleplaying with friends!

- Loot around the map!
- Huge and cool buildings!
- A fancy yacht!
- Tons of fun alone or with your friends!
- By Pixelusion & Pixel Smile Studios
